column3: MT 48:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. NASB sets the title in braces before verse 1. Close to the Hebrew.
“The remotest parts of Zaphon” is rendered “in the far north.”
Close to the Hebrew; “her fortresses” is rendered “her palaces.”
Close to the Hebrew; “we have reflected on” is rendered “We have thought on.”
Close to the Hebrew; “set your heart to” is rendered “Consider,” and “her fortresses” as “her palaces.”
Close to the Hebrew; “over dying” is rendered “until death.”
